points.why: Starts from an agreed shared event such as end-of-quarter deals needing a discount, put in the team's own words, and avoids opening with the conclusion.
Draws the loop live one link at a time and asks 'does this match what you've seen?' after each link.
Names the archetype only after someone in the room describes it, avoids blame phrasing, and treats pushback as a link or boundary to add or fix.
Records sales as consulted, lists finance, pricing, product marketing, comp and CS as not yet consulted, and plans the next room.

notes: It mostly separates consulted from not-yet-consulted rather than consulted from informed, but the substance is covered.
